headers.X-Requested-With: Opaque session token returned by redeem; absent for redeem

sessionPersistence: Frontend first-party Secure SameSite=Lax cookie, Path=/Horizons/App/; never store the original book code

linkBook.response: Bootstrap;409 if the code belongs to a different profile

attempt.id: client UUID unique per finished round

quizOptions.seed: exact seed used to generate the round

answers.submitted: choice text, typed answer, ordered token text array or pair.right

saveAttempt.response: Bootstrap plus attempt accepted/duplicate, awardedXp, and dailyStreakCelebration (object for the winning daily round, null otherwise)

dailyStreakCelebration.dayKey: YYYY-MM-DD in the saved profile time zone
dailyStreakCelebration.completedAt: server-created ISO timestamp of the original saved round
dailyStreakCelebration.timeZone: validated profile IANA zone, default America/Guayaquil
dailyStreakCelebration.streak: integer contiguous active days ending on dayKey
dailyStreakCelebration.minutesUntilMidnight: non-negative integer, rounded down using the actual next local date boundary; 0 means less than one minute; supports DST

dailyStreakPolicy.eligibility: First accepted finished Learn or Practice round in the profile-local day; correctness and mastery are not prerequisites. Existing history today suppresses new candidates.
dailyStreakPolicy.claim: Unique create-only daily-streak/profile/date claim in existing private HzThrottle JSON collection, after attempt and result reads succeed.
dailyStreakPolicy.retry: Same winning attempt UUID returns the same immutable event within its local day; other attempts and old-day retries return null. XP remains idempotent.
dailyStreakPolicy.presentation: Frontend persists profile/day seen only when shown. No bootstrap/login trigger. Exact winning UUID replay on another browser can present it again; there is no global display acknowledgement.
dailyStreakPolicy.trust: Server timestamp and profile timezone only; client streak, completion date, celebration, and candidate flags are ignored.

getLeaderboard.response: Authenticated public standings: week, endsAt, personal rank/name/nextRank, cutoff, minimumXp, previous result,20 rows with pseudonymous ID/name/avatar/weekly XP/self/bot/position. Enrolls caller; scores only from immutable server-graded attempts.

getSocialHome.response: Public own profile/statistics/counts plus human-first suggestions and following/followers/mutual friends lists.

request.targetId: Opaque public competitor ID or stable bot persona ID

getPublicProfile.response: Public profile, aggregate statistics, relationship state and social lists; no private learner fields.

setFollow.response: Updated public target relationship. Human friendship requires reciprocal active follows. Bots never reciprocate.

searchPeople.response: Up to12 public cards; minimum2 characters; humans first.

bootstrap.demo: boolean derived from private issued-code kind; true requires fictional profile details in shared public examples

statuses.409: book code linked to another profile or idempotency conflict

notes: Access starts once on first redemption and never resets on login
Any valid linked book code restores this same profile
A1 contains Unit1; A2 is a clearly labelled additional-book preview used to verify linking, not advertised as produced learning content
Requests from localhost are allowed for development; production origin is https://exams.bebrighton.net
Correctness, word IDs, mastery eligibility and XP are recomputed on the server with the shared seeded Unit1 engine; submitted correct/XP fields are ignored
Unknown or repeated question IDs are rejected; idempotency keys cannot overwrite previous answers
Recognition/memory rounds and hinted answers never increase mastery; one unaided correct answer masters the prompted item, including accepted synonyms
Public sample codes ending001 are kept fresh; backend live QA uses A1-019/020 and A2-010
Only registered activity IDs enter completedActivities; historical activity completions remain valid, and synthetic mixed rounds retain XP/history and vocabulary progress
Lesson completion follows the compact path topic IDs and their linked historical chunk/grammar completions without creating attempts, XP or mastery
Audio alternatives are reconstructed on the server from audioEnabled and original listening question IDs; clients cannot substitute arbitrary questions
Avatar badge none is free; star-pin/trophy-pin/compass-pin require25/100/250storedXP and locked selections return403 BADGE_LOCKED
Only saveAttempt can return a daily streak celebration; its winning event is claimed once per profile/local day and duplicate presentation is guarded by the client when actually shown

islandMastery.vocabulary: One unaided correct answer masters the prompted vocabulary item; accepted synonyms count. Mastery is retained.
islandMastery.skills: One unaided correct response per canonical grammar/reading/listening question. Silent alternatives do not master audio.
islandMastery.roundSelection: Frontend selects at most eight unseen/unmastered items from the full seeded canonical pool; server reconstructs and grades their IDs independently.
islandMastery.persistence: Derived from stored server-graded events; no client crown flag or new collection.
islandMastery.retry: Same saved attempt does not award XP or mastery twice.
